notes.title: Final Demo Update v 1.0.0.0.8 0917 (ADDED RETRO GAME FILTER!)
notes.content:
Optimized Options panel in the main menu.

Remade underwater controls: smoother movement with WASD + Space/Ctrl; releasing keys now stops instantly for easier pickups and interactions.

Optimized 3D models and SFX.

Added an experimental Retro Game Filter option.

notes.title: Final Demo Update v 1.0.0.0.7 0726
notes.content:
Increased font size in the intro level (UI and fonts will be fully polished in the full release).

Added a shop system in the deep sea level — players can now collect coins, buy ammo and food.

Added a hidden surprise.
